name: Sulzbach/Saar (Germany)
description: White field charged at the centre with the city arms of Sulzbach/Saar (crossed hammers and a white wavy bend on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Sulzbach/Saar; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Sulzbach arms — hammers and wavy bend on blue
